readme:
# Otodom Property Scraper

Collect property listings from [Otodom](https://www.otodom.pl), the Polish real estate portal. Give the actor any Otodom results link for sale or for rent and it returns one row per listing: price, price per square metre, rooms, area, floor, location, agency, photos and dates.

Only the public results pages are read. No login is used.

## What you get

- Listing id, slug, link and title
- Transaction (sale or rent) and property type (flat, house, room, plot, commercial, new development)
- Price as a number in PLN, price per square metre and the monthly fee when shown
- Rooms, area in square metres, plot area and floor
- Location: province, city, district, neighbourhood, street as shown, and the full location path
- Dates the listing was created and last pushed to the top
- Flags: promoted, exclusive, private owner
- Agency name, agency page, logo and the public name of the agency contact (empty for private owners, whose names are not collected)
- Photo count, the first photos, feature tags, walk, video and floor plan links when present
- New development details: development name and link, state, estimated delivery, unit counts and ranges

## Pricing

You pay per event.

| Event name | When it is charged | Price |
|---|---|---|
| `actor-start` | Once per run, together with the first listings delivered | $0.001 |
| `otodom-listing-result` | For each listing saved to the dataset | $1.50 per 1,000 |

A run that finds no listings is not charged. The actor stops cleanly when your maximum charge per run is reached.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `startUrls` | list of links | Otodom results links for sale (`sprzedaz`) or rent (`wynajem`). Filters in the link are kept. A `page` value in the link sets the first page. |
| `maxResults` | number | Maximum listings per link. Default 50. Otodom shows 36 listings per page. |

Leave the input empty to run a small demo: 5 flats for sale in Warsaw.

### Example: two searches

```json
{
  "startUrls": [
    "https://www.otodom.pl/pl/wyniki/sprzedaz/mieszkanie/mazowieckie/warszawa/warszawa/warszawa",
    "https://www.otodom.pl/pl/wyniki/wynajem/mieszkanie/malopolskie/krakow/krakow/krakow"
  ],
  "maxResults": 40
}
```

### Example: filtered search

Build the search on otodom.pl, copy the link from the address bar and paste it:

```json
{
  "startUrls": [
    "https://www.otodom.pl/pl/wyniki/sprzedaz/mieszkanie/mazowieckie/warszawa/warszawa/warszawa?priceMax=900000&roomsNumber=%5BTWO%2CTHREE%5D"
  ],
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

## Output sample

```json
{
  "listingId": 68542922,
  "slug": "mieszkanie-obok-petli-czerwone-maki-ID4DB90",
  "url": "https://www.otodom.pl/pl/oferta/mieszkanie-obok-petli-czerwone-maki-ID4DB90",
  "title": "Mieszkanie obok pętli Czerwone Maki",
  "transaction": "RENT",
  "estateType": "FLAT",
  "price": 2500,
  "currency": "PLN",
  "monthlyFee": 1050,
  "rooms": 2,
  "areaM2": 50,
  "floor": 2,
  "province": "małopolskie",
  "city": "Kraków",
  "district": "Dębniki",
  "neighborhood": "Ruczaj",
  "street": "ul. Czerwone Maki",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-19T12:42:25Z",
  "pushedUpAt": "2026-11-06T09:59:19+01:00",
  "isPromoted": false,
  "isPrivateOwner": false,

  "agencyUrl": "https://www.otodom.pl/pl/firma/wiz-estates-ID3695931",

```

Fields without a value are returned as `null`. The dataset has more fields than shown here, see the Output tab.

## Limitations

- Only data on the results pages is returned. Full descriptions, phone numbers and details found only on a single listing page are not collected.
- Otodom does not publish coordinates on results pages. `mapRadiusM` shows how approximate the map point is.
- `shortDescription` is empty on most listings because Otodom does not show it on the results pages.
- One search shows a limited number of pages. Narrow the search with filters to reach more listings.
- Otodom sometimes refuses a request. The actor retries on a fresh connection up to 3 times per page. If a page still fails it is skipped and the status message says so. A run where every page fails ends with an error and no charge.
- Results change over time. Two runs a few hours apart can return different listings and prices.
- Names of private owners are never collected.

## FAQ

**Which Otodom links work?**
Results links that start with `https://www.otodom.pl/pl/wyniki/`, for sale or for rent, any property type and location. Links to a single listing are not accepted.

**Why did I get fewer listings than `maxResults`?**
The search has fewer matches, or the last page was reached. The status message at the end of the run says how many listings were delivered.

**Does the same listing appear twice?**
No. Each listing id is returned once per run, even if it is shown on two pages or in two links.

**Is a promoted or new development entry included?**
Yes, promoted listings are returned with `isPromoted` set. Entries inside new developments are returned with the development fields filled.

**Is a run restarted safely?**
Yes. Progress is saved after every batch. If a run is moved to another server it continues where it stopped, without duplicate rows and without charging twice.

**Can I use the data for commercial purposes?**
You are responsible for how you use the data and for following Otodom's terms and the data protection rules that apply to you.
